columns.name: record_type
columns.meaning: derivation, event or dropped

columns.name: segment_id
columns.meaning: The transcript segment

columns.name: extractor_version
columns.meaning: The extractor that derived it; null on a dropped row

columns.name: derivation_id
columns.meaning: The derivation's identity, as 32 hex characters; null on a dropped row

columns.name: derived_at
columns.meaning: When the hub derived it; null on a dropped row

columns.name: complete
columns.meaning: The marker's own flag: false when the derivation stopped short; derivation rows only

columns.name: event_count
columns.meaning: How many event rows the derivation holds; derivation rows only

columns.name: dropped_at
columns.meaning: When the hub dropped the segment's events; dropped rows only

columns.name: kind
columns.meaning: file_read, skill_invocation or agent_spawn; extensible; event rows only

columns.name: subject
columns.meaning: The path, the skill name, or the spawned agent type; null when the extractor names none

columns.name: tool
columns.meaning: The tool the turn called

columns.name: turn_path
columns.meaning: The event's place in the segment; event rows only

columns.name: occurrence
columns.meaning: The event's place in the segment; event rows only

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.meaning: The turn's own time, when the transcript carries one

columns.name: depth
columns.meaning: 0 for the main conversation, plus one per subagent nesting; event rows only

columns.name: agent_type
columns.meaning: The nearest enclosing subagent's type; null at depth 0

columns.name: step_key
columns.meaning: The runner step the segment came from, by chunk and epoch

columns.name: trace_id
columns.meaning: That step's derived trace id, as 32 hex characters

columns.name: step_started_at
columns.meaning: When that step started; the row's partition and backfill time

columns.name: chunk_id
columns.meaning: The segment's chunk

columns.name: epoch
columns.meaning: The segment's epoch

columns.name: spawn_generation
columns.meaning: Which worker spawn on the lease produced the segment

columns.name: graph_id
columns.meaning: The graph the step stood in

columns.name: graph_name
columns.meaning: The graph's name

columns.name: node_id
columns.meaning: The node

columns.name: node_name
columns.meaning: The node's name

columns.name: harness_id
columns.meaning: As derived; event rows only

columns.name: harness_version
columns.meaning: As derived; event rows only

columns.name: model
columns.meaning: As derived; event rows only

columns.name: effort
columns.meaning: As derived; event rows only

columns.name: exported_at
columns.meaning: When this copy of the row was written
